snippet.title: Opening Movie - Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter
snippet.description:
Catch a glimpse of this epic 1st journey into #TrailsintheSky1st in this all-new Opening Movie! Experience this, and so much more, in the demo available now on PS5 and Steam. The Nintendo Switch version will be available at a later date.

Play the demo now!
